findings.comment: Building Finished Floor Elevations (FFE) are inconsistent across sheets. Sheet 9 lists Bldg 1 FFE as 687.50, Bldg 3 as 685.50, and Bldg 4 as 685.50. Sheet 30 lists Bldg 1 FFE as 688.50, Bldg 3 as 688.0, and Bldg 4 as 685.0. Technical design data must be identical across all occurrences. Update the Existing Tree Plan (Sheet 30) to match the authoritative values shown on the Site Plan (Sheet 9).

applicableAreas: Sheet 18 (Austin Water General Information & Construction Notes)
findings.comment: The Austin Water General Notes sheet contains required fields that are left blank. Specifically, the Address field in the Meter Notice Potable Meter(s) section is blank for both the 6" Combination Potable Domestic & Fire meter and the 3/4" Irrigation meter. Complete all required fields in the Meter Notice section per current Austin Water standards.
